name: Fox’s Cunning, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 5, bard 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, unchained summoner 5

Duration 10 min./2 levels

This spell functions as fox’s cunning, except it grants an enhancement bonus to Intelligence equal to 1/2 your caster level.
